description: Retrieves a specific attachment from a Trello card by card ID and attachment ID.

fields.description: Specifies the fields to be returned for the attachment. Use 'all' to retrieve all available fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: bytes, date, edgeColor, fileName, idMember, isMalicious, isUpload, mimeType, name, pos, previews, url.
fields.title: Fields

idAttachment.description: The unique identifier of the specific attachment to be retrieved from the card.
idAttachment.title: Id Attachment

idCard.description: The unique identifier or the short link of the Trello card from which to retrieve the attachment.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: get_cards_attachments_by_id_card_by_id_attachment

AttachmentPreview.description: Preview thumbnail object for image attachments

_id.description: Alternative identifier for the preview, same as id.
_id.title: Id

bytes.description: Size of the preview image in bytes.
bytes.title: Bytes

height.description: Height of the preview image in pixels.
height.title: Height

scaled.description: Indicates whether the preview image has been scaled from the original.
scaled.title: Scaled

url.description: URL to access the preview image.
url.title: Url

width.description: Width of the preview image in pixels.
width.title: Width

AttachmentPreview.title: AttachmentPreview

bytes.description: Size of the attachment in bytes. Only present for uploaded files.
bytes.title: Bytes

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the attachment was added to the card.
date.title: Date

edgeColor.description: Dominant edge color of the attachment, represented as a hex color code.
edgeColor.title: Edge Color

idMember.description: Unique identifier of the member who added the attachment.
idMember.title: Id Member

isMalicious.description: Indicates whether the attachment has been flagged as potentially malicious.
isMalicious.title: Is Malicious

isUpload.description: Indicates whether the attachment is an uploaded file (true) or a URL link (false).
isUpload.title: Is Upload

mimeType.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'image/png', 'application/pdf'). Only present for uploaded files.
mimeType.title: Mime Type

pos.description: Position of the attachment used for ordering attachments on the card.
pos.title: Pos

previews.description: Array of preview objects containing thumbnails at various sizes. Only present for image attachments.
previews.title: Previews
